tier1.text: The anterior spinal artery carries blood to the anterior, or front, part of the spinal cord. This artery runs along the front surface of the spinal cord. The vertebral arteries pass through the neck and enter the skull. Branches from the left and right vertebral arteries merge to form the anterior spinal artery.

quotes.quote: A second set of vessels that supply the CNS are the vertebral arteries, which are protected as they pass through the neck region by the transverse foramina of the cervical vertebrae. The vertebral arteries enter the cranium through the foramen magnum of the occipital bone.
